evidence_quotes.O: After purchasing the listed 4 items, I had to play them with the various types of music I listen to, Rap/HipHop, R&B;, Classical, Jazz, and Country.
evidence_quotes.C: All test were done with the SSD installed in the Main HDD Bay1, not the Optical Bay with SATA III on both the 2011 and 2012 MacBook Pro's.
evidence_quotes.E: I am an avid MacBook Pro user and do a lot of hardware reviews for Apple products.
evidence_quotes.A: Not sure if Nikon even has Quality Control like Canon, but I shouldn't have to buy 3 of these lenses to get 1 good one.
evidence_quotes.N: As far as sound goes, they are simply awful in every way. I broke these in for over 72 hours and they sound like crap still.
